description: This file contains the implementation of the iScroll library, a JavaScript-based scrolling utility that enables smooth scrolling and custom scrollbars for web content, particularly on mobile devices. It defines the iScroll class with methods for handling touch/mouse events, scrolling, snapping, and scrollbar management.

classes.name: iScroll
classes.description: Main class implementing custom scrolling behavior, event handling, and scrollbar management.

classes.name: scrollbar
classes.description: Helper class for creating and managing custom scrollbar elements.

methods.name: iScroll
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the scrolling object with target element and options.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates scroll dimensions and updates scrollbar positions.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Sets the scroll position with optional scrollbar updates.

methods.name: scrollTo
methods.description: Animates scrolling to specified x,y coordinates over a given duration.

methods.name: scrollToPage
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific page or position, supporting 'next' and 'prev' commands.

methods.name: scrollToElement
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific DOM element.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners and optionally removes the wrapper element.
